recorded_by: A1 MARKET-DATA-PLANE-V2 (F4 closure; V1 append-only erratum, original V1 bytes untouched)
subject: research/control/market_data_plane_v1_run/perf_run_latest.json (schema mdp_perf_run@1)
finding: V1 recorded resource.getrusage(...).ru_maxrss under the field name 'peak_rss_kb'. On the V1 Darwin host ru_maxrss reports BYTES, not KiB; the field name therefore misdescribes the unit for that run.
erratum: V1 perf_run_latest.json peak_rss_kb = 1293058048 on the V1 Darwin host means 1293058048 BYTES = 1293058048 / 1048576 = 1233.15625 MiB (about 1233.2 MiB), NOT 1293058048 KiB (~1.2 TiB).
status: V1 baseline bytes are NOT rewritten (append-only evidence); V2 replaces the schema with mdp_perf_run@2 which carries platform, peak_rss_raw, peak_rss_raw_unit, peak_rss_bytes and peak_rss_mib explicitly (research/market_data_plane/perf_metrics.py; tests/test_mdp_perf_portable.py)
